title: PlanV3
description: A short-lived execution authority derived from a validated profile.

host.description: Endpoint for which the plan is valid.

input.description: Digest identity for all plan-affecting input.

intent.description: Command-bound intent authorized by this plan.

metadata.description: Planner metadata with no execution semantics.

profile_digest.description: Canonical digest of the validated profile.

profile_id.description: Profile this plan was derived from.

run_id.description: Reserved worker run identity that a result must retain.

source.description: Trusted source identity for the input.

ActionId.description: Stable identity of an action in a profile or plan.

CapabilityId.description: A bounded, non-empty capability key (for example `defender.health`).

ExecutionIntent.description: Intent selected at the unprivileged command boundary.

oneOf.description: Inspect current endpoint state.
Produce a short-lived host-bound plan.
Execute a previously verified plan.

HostIdentityV3.description: Identity information that binds a plan to the intended endpoint.

boot_id.description: Operating-system boot identifier; prevents a plan crossing a reboot boundary.

fingerprint.description: Canonical digest binding these identity fields.

host_id.description: Stable worker-defined endpoint identifier, not an authentication secret.

hostname.description: Current computer name for operator display.

os_version.description: Operating-system version returned by the worker.

digest.description: Canonical digest of all input bytes that affect the plan.

size_bytes.description: Number of input bytes used to calculate the digest.

captured_at.description: Capture time for the whole observation bundle.

digest.description: Canonical digest of the exact observation bundle.

ObservedValueV3.description: A capability-provided value captured before planning.

observed_at.description: Time the capability observed this value.

Operation.description: Whether an action is observation-only or can alter the endpoint.

oneOf.description: Gather state without applying a desired configuration.
Produce a host-bound, expiring plan without changing endpoint state.
Apply an already validated plan.

OsFamily.description: The Windows or cross-platform operating-system family that a capability supports.

oneOf.description: Microsoft Windows.
Linux.
macOS.
An explicitly unsupported or unrecognized platform.

PlanId.description: Stable identity of a signed planning decision.

PlannedActionV3.description: One worker-derived action with capability-owned execution authority.

action_id.description: Action identity, unique within a plan.

capability_id.description: Registered capability selected by the profile step.

continue_on_error.description: Continue after a failed action for audit and plan only. Apply always fails fast.

depends_on.description: Derived action identities that must complete successfully first.

facts_digest.description: Stable digest of the facts used by the capability to derive this action.

operation.description: Operation supplied by the trusted execution boundary.

parameters.description: Operator-provided capability parameters, validated by the planner.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must remain true at apply time.

source_step_id.description: Profile step from which the trusted worker derived this action.

PreconditionV3.description: A typed prerequisite evaluated by the planner or worker.

oneOf.description: The worker must have (or deliberately not have) elevation.
The worker token must contain a named privilege.

The plan is bound to the captured host fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: Canonical digest of host identity fields.

oneOf.description: The action depends on a specific observed-state capture.

digest.description: Canonical digest of the state capture.

oneOf.description: The action requires a particular operating-system family and optional minimum version.

minimum_version.description: Capability-defined minimum version, compared by the capability.

Privilege.description: An execution privilege recognized by the v3 worker boundary.

oneOf.description: No elevated token is required.
A local administrator token is required.
The local system account is required.
Windows backup/restore privileges are required.
Windows security-log and security-policy privileges are required.

RebootRequirement.description: Reboot consequence advertised before an action is applied.

oneOf.description: No reboot is expected.
A reboot can be deferred but may be needed for complete effect.
A reboot is required for the requested outcome.

Reversibility.description: Ability to return from an action to its previous state.

oneOf.description: The action has no persistent side effects.
A rollback action is complete and deterministic.
A rollback is possible only while retained artifacts or system state remain available.
The action cannot be rolled back by `BaselineOps`.

RiskLevel.description: Risk classification supplied by a capability author.

oneOf.description: No endpoint mutation and little sensitivity.
Local read-only inspection or low-impact operation.
A guarded change with a local scope.
A change that can materially alter endpoint availability or security.
A change that needs explicit, out-of-band operator confirmation.

RunId.description: Stable identity of one worker execution attempt.

SchemaVersion.description: Wire version for every v3 document.

oneOf.description: `BaselineOps` v3.0 contract.

Sha256Digest.description: Lowercase, 32-byte SHA-256 digest used to bind profiles, plans, and evidence.

SourceIdentityV3.description: Source provenance that remains stable enough to validate at apply time.

digest.description: Digest of the source content as received.

locator.description: Operator-readable origin label or normalized URI.

SourceKind.description: The origin category of profile or configuration input.

oneOf.description: A local, operator-supplied file.
A profile embedded in the signed distribution.
A source retrieved through an explicitly trusted remote workflow.
Input constructed by a caller through the public API.
